card.name: The word since after a time claim
card.fires_on: The word "since" meaning from a past point until now, right after a noun or verb phrase such as "every decade", "worst crisis" or "increased steadily". It is common in general web text on history and news.

modes.label: Superlative or first since
modes.description: "since" after "first", "worst" or a similar claim, followed by a past event or era.

modes.label: Change continuing since then
modes.description: "since" after a verb or a person or time noun, followed by "then" or a past date.

card.writes: It favors Chinese tokens and word starts, which is weak and unclear, so there is no clear output effect beyond what follows "since".
card.plain: It lights up on "since" when a sentence compares the present to a past event or era.
